name: Zephith Yarra
keeps: what one world owes another and has not said
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: Held that the stars were suns with worlds of their own.
text: Zephith yarra of the quiet lamp, carries between for the 6th tranche, doors 48 to 57. Keeps what one world owes another and has not said. Reads Giordano Bruno.
